Question 14
?

Let C be the set of all multiples of 10 greater than 0 and let D be the the set of all multiples of 5 greater than 0. What is C∖D?

a
{15,30,45,60,75,…}
b
{10,20,30,40,50,60,70,…}
c
∅
d
{5,10,15,20,25,30,35,40,45,50,55,60,65,70,75,…}
e
{5,15,25,35,45,55,65,75,…}
